rubric.rounding: Exact Decimal weighted sum; ROUND_HALF_UP to 1 decimal per unique image. Cohort means use rounded totals exactly; threshold comparison uses unrounded mean.

blind_freeze.method: Each original individually via view_image detail=original, no contact sheets or prior stages. All 32 viewed before any prior numeric report. Four brand-only KyNotes originals then viewed for ky_fit.
violations: Assignment itself disclosed prior qualitative objections, reported fixes and the statement that Sol had no visual8 blocker. This is contextual expectation priming; the assessment is blind to numeric per-image/cohort priors, not fully blind to treatment or prior qualitative verdict.

validation.near_duplicate_rule: different pixel fraction <0.001 AND maximum RGB channel delta <=8

capture_conditions.driver: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium 153.0.8010.12, device scale 1, normal service worker behavior
capture_conditions.fonts: self-hosted Space Grotesk bundled in web/dist; Space Grotesk loaded: true
